checks.detail: W388A.3 contract has no internal violations
EONBOT recognizes explicit shareable/remix requests and routes to canonical Workspace
command prepares a local draft and never marks a task complete
chat intent is written only from the visible user CTA handler
intent excludes attachments, chat history, credentials, media and accounts
intent is bounded to browser session storage and expires
intent creates no connection, publishing, tracking, or referral value
secret-looking requests are rejected from the handoff

limitations: No model output is made public, no social platform is connected, no content is posted, no recipient account is created, and no referral reward or measurement is enabled.
